textRuns.value: Every finding comes from the database view finance.invoice_audit (migrations 015 / 019): each invoice is recomputed from the progressive Suez toll bands. Check: duplicate_charge, tonnage_mismatch, amount_mismatch (with its probable cause), rate_mismatch.

Review = error: the invoice is wrong and needs a corrected invoice or a credit note. Review = manual_review: a ballast chemical tanker billed at the Crude Oil ballast rate — the tariff Notes allow it for oil / chemical tankers, so a person confirms the vessel type; it is not counted as an error.
The agents' invoice_audit tool reads the same view, so this page and the weekly deck agree.
